reason: A Markdown sidebar viewer and editor focused on precise block- and text-range annotation, with structured revision requests sent to the chat interface.

summaries.zh: 在侧边栏预览和编辑 Markdown 文件，支持块级与文字选区批注，并将批注整理为结构化修改指令发送到聊天框。
summaries.en: Preview and edit Markdown files in a sidebar, add block-level or text-range annotations, and format them as structured revision instructions for the chat input.

capabilities: Displays and edits Markdown files in a sidebar
Adds block-level and text-range annotations with labels
Writes structured annotation instructions into the chat input
Exports current annotations as a JSON backup
Stores annotations in browser memory during plugin use
